I replied to Ysolde in her direct message to confirm that Bay 47 is now her dock for Sableness Tire Supply pickups on the Nettle project.

I didn't save it as a separate gbrain note. The brain already stores her direct message as a fact that only she can see. The tool for adding a note didn't show who would be able to read it, so a separate copy might have reached other members. I took no other action.
